item.title: "What will happen?"
item.description: With Election Day here, MAGA allies are making one final push to sway voters, rolling out mountains of messaging aimed at energizing their base and defending the movement’s record. But with voters weighing the economy, the administration’s policies and the direction of the country, will the last-minute appeal resonate? Scott Galloway and Jessica Tarlov discuss, on Raging Moderates.
